organizations.publicNote: American record-label imprint. Victor 4381 was manufactured by RCA Manufacturing Company in 1938; the label is represented separately from that corporate body.

sources.fullCitation: Allan Jones, tenor, with orchestra conducted by Nathaniel Shilkret. “Cosi Cosa.” Victor 4381, side B, 1938. Digital transfer on YouTube. Accessed 21 August 2026.
sources.title: Cosi Cosa — Victor 4381

sources.researchNote: The upload description gives 13 January 1938 as the recording date and identifies the performance as the version Jones sang in Everybody Sing, three years after introducing the song in A Night at the Opera. The label is not shown. The transfer that carried this citation was withdrawn from the archive in favour of the digitised British issue of the same session.
